status: round-3 blocks: estimates with their world-clustered bootstrap intervals, and each comparison with the threshold of the design
units: fractions (x 100 for percent or pp); 95% world-clustered bootstrap, 2,000 draws, seed 996

tests.threshold: <= 10 pp or CI incl. 0; >= 20 pp, CI > 0

sonnet_r0_below_70pct.threshold: r_0 of Claude Sonnet 5.5 on changed definition items after S_src < 70%

notes.H1: B x D with the authored D=1 cells (the main-study contrast); the D_m version is reported. Bounds: at most 10 pp or the interval includes 0; at least 20 pp with the interval above 0.
notes.H2: r_0 = ContractValid of the changed definition item-times the source-epoch key invalidated in D0B1_source after S_src (the `r` of Eq. (1), whose main-study value is 16.2%); r_0 - 0.162 >= 20 pp (point estimate). The same quantity of Qwen3.5-9B on the same worlds, and the paired difference, are reported.
notes.H: validity: at most 10% of the writer's distinct write requests stop at the output limit (`finish_reason` "length" in calls.jsonl: max_tokens or the context window), at most 2% unreadable (`within_limits`); H1 and H2 are computed only within these limits. calls.jsonl records the finish reason, prompt and output tokens (thinking included) but not whether the reply parsed; the unreadable share is per distinct request from the response cache when given, else from the run summaries' `def_stats` (per cell write, so a request several cells send counts once per cell), and `basis` says which.
notes.H3: repair and mechanical repair, S_src and S_def, D1B1_source minus D0thinkB1_source on definition items, each >= 30 pp; computed only when at most 10% of the thinking writes are cut off (completion tokens at the run's limit). The share of unreadable thinking writes against 20% is reported beside it.
